text:
Jordan: Thanks for the questions during the reliability segment. Posting the concise follow-up + RCA (https://redwood.in/rca/205000). Please ack owners and volunteer here so we can close the all-hands action tracker.
Priya: Can someone drop a very short timeline here for execs and customers? the RCA is detailed and folks are skimming.
Sam: Timeline (short): 03:05 alert, 03:12 mitigation (routing fallback), 03:35 targeted cache bump, 03:50 full recovery. Root cause: eviction cascade on a small subset of shards triggered by two request patterns.
Mei: Added infra notes in RCA about placement policy & uneven shard weight. Short-term mitigations listed; medium-term is rebalance + eviction logic fix.
Ravi: I'll own an automated cache-bump playbook (targeted, hot-shard only) + rollback guardrails. Plan: infra flag + metric threshold + safety cutoff. ETA: 4 business days.
Taylor: I'll own customer comms. Proposal: 3-bullet customer note + an enterprise FAQ. Need Legal to quick-review the FAQ. Drafting now, ETA tomorrow noon. @Lindsey can you help with legal review?
Lindsey: Happy to review. Send draft here and I'll prioritize.
Jordan: Leadership also asked for a short decision matrix: when to do model fallback vs cross-region failover vs capacity scale. Who can draft criteria with cost deltas?
Priya: I can draft the matrix and map it to our SLOs. Will need Sam/Mei for signal names. Draft by Thu.
Sam: Will send exact metric names and example alert windows to the RCA by EOD. Also proposing a small CI replay test for the two repro request shapes (ticket RH-4823).
Mei: I'll open an RFC for the shard rebalance plan and include risk analysis + rollout phasing. Tagging infra-ops. ETA: next sprint RFC.
IncidentBot: incident:205000 acknowledged 03:05, mitigated 03:35, recovered 03:50. RCA link: https://redwood.in/rca/205000
Jordan: Capturing action items (owners + due dates) 
```
- D1: Automated targeted cache-bump + guardrails (Ravi)  due: 4bd
- D2: SLO-decision matrix + cost delta (Priya + Sam)  due: 5bd
- D3: Customer note + enterprise FAQ (Taylor + Lindsey)  due: 1bd
- D4: Shard rebalance RFC + timeline (Mei)  due: next sprint
- D5: CI replay tests for repro shapes (Sam)  due: 2w (RH-4823)
- D6: Postmortem publish + status page update (Jordan)  due: today EOD
- D7: Add KV cache pressure metric + alert (Ravi + Mei)  due: 2w
```
Ravi: Acked D1/D7. Quick question: should the cache metric be reported from all hosts or GPU-only? I suggest all hosts but tag with host_role.
Priya: All hosts for visibility. otherwise we lose blind spots.
Taylor: For the comms, do we want an anonymized timeline + short remediation bullets? recommend yes.
Lindsey: Legal prefers non-technical language in customer-facing text; keep it to 2-3 simple bullets and link to the full RCA for details.
Sam: I'll prototype the replay harness tomorrow and post link to RH-4823 when ready. Also adding a small Redwood Optimize eval to detect regression from quantized cache paths.
Mei: On the rebalance RFC I'll include a canary rollout plan and a rollback checklist.
DeployBot: deploy:infra/cache-toggle 2050004450 started by Ravi  staging toggle running.
Jordan: One additional leadership ask: a 2-sentence exec summary for Friday's board sync. Who can craft that after Priya's matrix?
Priya: I'll produce the 2-sentence exec summary once matrix is drafted.
Jordan: Great. Please post short progress updates in this thread as you make moves so I can close items in the tracker. If anyone needs help, ping @oncall and flag in #eng-oncall.
Taylor: Acked D3. I'll post a draft here in 6-8 hours and tag Lindsey.
Ravi: Starting instrumentation work now and will link PR. Acked D1/D7.
Sam: Acked D2/D5. Will upload metric names + replay scripts.
Mei: Acked D4. Opening RFC today and will tag infra-ops.
Jordan: Thanks all for quick ownership. I'll update the all-hands action tracker after folks ack. :raised_hands:
